svg.aria-label: The three dashboard banners that appear while charging continues
svg.title: Dashboard banners: charging continues
svg.desc: Two amber banners for reduced power (pack warm, at cell current limit) and one blue informational banner for ignoring bad data from the bike. In all three cases charging carries on.

g.text: Normal on a hot day. Charging continues safely at a lower rate.
🛡 Reduced power — at cell current limit
Requested power exceeds the cells' 1 C rating, so it has been capped.
ℹ Ignoring bad data from bike
Corrupted CAN messages discarded. Charging unaffected. Clears after 10 s.
